newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa longer term paper seen better buy.
newsitem.headline: Televisa longer term paper seen better buy.

text.p: Grupo Televisa longer-dated paper is a better bet following an improvement in the television company's balance sheet after the sale of its PanAmSat shares, said Bear Stearns & Co economist Mark S. Agnew.
"The risks in Televisa have come down and therefore the longer-dated paper becomes more interesting," Agnew said.

"We recommend selling the 1997 paper (which trades 50 basis points inside the sovereign curve), and buying longer date paper to pick up 28 basis points to 69 basis points over the sovereign curve," Agnew said in a report.
Televisa will receive $600 million from the sale of its shares in PanAmSat to Hughes Electronics Corp, it said.
Bear Stearns says this will reduce Televisa's net debt/EBITDA for the latest 12 months to 1.84 times from 5.25 times.
